name: omatic-server-connection
description: o-MATIC Server Connection: reuses the host's OAuth/SSO to reach an existing o-MATIC Server over MCP (cloud default, or an operator-entered on-prem URL). It does not create a Server, dispatch agents, or change authentication.

SERVER_URL.title: o-MATIC Server URL
SERVER_URL.description: Cloud default: https://factory.o-matic.ai/mcp. For on-premises, enter the HTTPS MCP URL for that Server.
